MSE_and_signal_y_limits: matplotlib autoscale using actual points inside displayed x window only; no influence from hidden first-step values; numerical y ticks always shown
seed_summary: all completed seeds, arithmetic mean with min-max band, not confidence interval
missing_policy: NA; never zero-fill, extrapolate or mix partial runs into finished-condition means
fixed_S1: original per-checkpoint refitted linear head, same original S1 test images
current_support: same original S1 tasks only, evaluated on S1/S2/S3 probe group as each stage arrives; support changes so not a forgetting measure
frozen_S1: original S1 head saved at arrival900/model899, including train mean/std, evaluated only from900 on same S1 images
stable: same parent model and full Adam state forked after1000 updates; S1-only continuation
paired_effect: 100 * ((changing_post-changing_pre)-(stable_post-stable_pre)), per seed, not significance or causal proof
purpose: exploratory diagnosis, no outcome-based weights, seed selection, label changes or class merging
